Free version, type, income sources, what it submits and CIS come from HMRC's software finder (read 18 November 2026). "CIS on tax return" means HMRC lists the product as ready to report Construction Industry Scheme deductions on your tax return. Prices and joint-property support come from each provider's own website (checked 18 November 2026, or the later date shown on a product's page). How we check.

Free options we have price-checked

These are free, or have a free plan, according to the provider's own website. Free plans usually have limits, so read the note before you choose.

  • ANNA Self Assessment: Free plan includes MTD filing – ANNA's Free plan is £0/month ('pay for what you use') and lists 'MTD ITSA filing – free'. Optional Auto Accountant (prepares and files your MTD updates for you): first 4 months free, then £29/month. Paid business plans from £12.90 a month + VAT. Needs an ANNA account.
  • Landlord Studio: Free up to 3 properties + £5 per MTD submission; Pro £12 + VAT/month – MTD Go plan is free for up to 3 properties but charges £5 per MTD tax submission. Pro £12 + VAT/month (£144 a year + VAT) includes free MTD submissions; 14-day free trial, no card needed.
  • PaTMa Property Manager: Free for 1 unit; Pro £15/month – Free plan covers 1 rental unit. Pro £15/month for 5 units (extra units £1.50/unit/month). All prices include VAT. 14-day Pro trial, no card needed.
  • Tide Accounting: Free for sole traders – Tide's MTD for Income Tax features are built into its free business account ('Everything you need to stay MTD-compliant, completely free'), including automated quarterly submissions; you can connect another bank via Open Banking. Accounting add-on plans: £0.00/month for sole traders, then £5.99 + VAT/month and up. One-month free trial of Admin Extra.
  • Zoho: Free plan; paid from £10/month billed annually – Zoho Books Free plan is £0 and lists MTD for Income Tax (Sole Traders & Landlords tab). Standard plan is £10/org/month billed annually (£12 billed monthly), with a free trial.
  • Sage Sole Trader & Landlord Free: Free – Sage Sole Trader Free: 'Completely free, no billing.' 25 auto-categorised transactions per month, 1 bank account, records landlord income and expenses, Making Tax Digital ready.
  • Aligned.tax MTD for Spreadsheets: Free for individuals – Filing your own quarterly updates is free for individuals; accountants pay per client from the 2027/28 tax year.
  • FreeAgent for free with Mettle, NatWest & RBS: Free for eligible bank customers – Free while you keep a NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland or Ulster Bank business current account, or a Mettle account with at least one transaction a month.
  • GetGround: Free (Basic plan) – MTD for landlords free with GetGround's Basic plan.

Common questions

Does HMRC provide free software for Making Tax Digital?

HMRC's guidance says you, or an agent, will need to use commercial software that works with Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. It also says free products are available for people with simple tax affairs, but they may have limits, such as a set number of transactions. Source: GOV.UK, Choose the right software

What is MTD bridging software?

Bridging software connects to records you already keep, such as a spreadsheet, and sends your quarterly updates to HMRC. Some bridging products also submit your tax return; others only send the updates. Use the 'Bridging (spreadsheets)' filter above to see them, or read our guide to spreadsheets and bridging software.

Can I use more than one MTD product?

Yes. HMRC says you can use more than one product, but only one product for each separate submission. For example, a landlord cannot use two products to send the same property quarterly update. If you combine products, make sure together they cover your quarterly updates and your tax return. Source: GOV.UK, Choose the right software

When are MTD quarterly updates due?

For both standard and calendar update periods, the deadlines are 7 August, 7 November, 7 February and 7 May (the following tax year). Source: GOV.UK, Send quarterly updates. For what happens if one is late, see MTD penalty points explained. For how the two period types differ, see standard vs calendar update periods.

Does HMRC recommend any MTD software?

No. HMRC says it does not recommend any product or software provider. Every product in this directory has been through HMRC's recognition process. We show our featured products first, because we may earn a commission from them (see our affiliate disclosure), then every other product under Best of the rest. Within each group, price-checked products come first, paid plans before their free variants, then A to Z. You can still filter, including to free versions only. Right now no affiliate links are live, so a commission does not change this order.

Why does a product say 'Quarterly updates only'?

HMRC lists some products as able to send quarterly updates but not to submit your tax return. If you pick one of those, you'll need another product, or an agent, for the tax return after the year ends.
